deviations.why: No real testimonials data available and policy forbids invention; SECTION_POLICY.testimonial = frozenset()
No booking flow exists in the intake data; no real endpoint or process to support it

deviations.what: Removed '12 Years of Experiences' counter circle
deviations.why: No verifiable years of experience metric in the business data; would be fabricated

deviations.what: Timeline dates replaced with service duration/step number
deviations.why: Original used specific dates; no date field exists in the data contract, so we use available service attributes (duration, num) to preserve the alternating layout without inventing dates

notes: Faithful port of Medic Care template. Hero uses scroll-snap for slider (no JS). Timeline structure preserved with alternating cards and central line; icons replaced by service numbers. FindUs component used as contact/map section to satisfy shared component contract. All colors defined as spine variables in .root, with --vt-on-accent set to #000000 to ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 on accent background. Overflow issues addressed via .contactSection overflow-x: hidden and adjusted nav padding on mobile.
